description: This file defines the 'SugarChart' class, which is responsible for generating, processing, and rendering XML data for charts in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for constructing chart data, managing URLs and XML generation, currency formatting, and handling chart display options.

classes.name: SugarChart
classes.description: This class encapsulates functionality for creating, managing, and rendering chart data in XML format for the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarChart object, setting up database connection, user preferences, chart properties, and default configurations.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches data from the database based on the provided query and populates the data_set array.

methods.name: constructBaseURL
methods.description: Builds the base URL from the base_url array parameters.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Constructs the full URL including URL parameters and additional parameters, encoding them properly.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data_set array with provided data.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties of the chart such as title, subtitle, type, legend, labels, and print options.

methods.name: setDisplayProperty
methods.description: Sets individual display properties of the chart.

methods.name: setColors
methods.description: Sets the list of colors used in the chart.

methods.name: xmlHeader
methods.description: Returns the XML header for the chart XML file.

methods.name: xmlFooter
methods.description: Returns the XML footer for the chart XML file.

methods.name: xmlProperties
methods.description: Builds XML string for chart properties and colors.

methods.name: xmlYAxis
methods.description: Builds XML string representing y-axis configuration based on chart data.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total for a specific group in the dataset.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Creates a string with specified depth of tab characters prepended.

methods.name: tabValue
methods.description: Generates an XML element with proper indentation, escaping special characters.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes the dataset grouping data based on group_by parameter.

methods.name: processDataGroup
methods.description: Creates XML for a data group element, optionally hiding associated data links.

methods.name: calculateGroupByTotal
methods.description: Sums values across a dataset, used for group summaries.

methods.name: calculateSingleBarMax
methods.description: Finds maximum value in a dataset for bar chart scaling.

methods.name: checkYAxis
methods.description: Adjusts yMin and yMax of the chart based on input value.

methods.name: convertCurrency
methods.description: Converts an amount to the user's preferred currency using conversion rate.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with locale-specific decimal and thousand separators.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns total sum of the dataset, considering grouping.

methods.name: xmlDataForGroupByChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for a group by chart, including subgroup details.

methods.name: xmlDataForGaugeChart
methods.description: Generates XML data specifically for gauge charts.

methods.name: xmlDataBarChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for bar chart type.

methods.name: xmlDataGenericChart
methods.description: Generates XML data for generic chart types.

methods.name: nullGroup
methods.description: Creates a placeholder group of data for missing or null values.

methods.name: getXMLFileName
methods.description: Static method returning a filename for chart XML cache based on user and file ID.

methods.name: processXmlData
methods.description: Determines what XML data to generate based on chart type.

methods.name: xmlData
methods.description: Wraps the chart's XML data in the overall data element.

methods.name: generateXML
methods.description: Builds the complete XML string including header, properties, data, axes, and footer.

methods.name: saveXMLFile
methods.description: Saves the generated XML content into a cache file.

methods.name: generateChartStrings
methods.description: Creates XML string for chart-related internationalized strings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns HTML to embed the chart in a webpage, generating necessary chart strings if missing.

methods.name: getDashletScript
methods.description: Prepares JavaScript snippets for embedding chart dashlets with resource URLs.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts and optionally translates dataset based on specified key columns.
